system.description:
Once per Doom Quarter, use a Move Action to teleport up to 60 ft. Every enemy within 5 ft of where you started or where you arrive is knocked Prone.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.95
system.summary: Once per Doom Quarter, use a Move Action to teleport up to 60 ft. Every enemy within 5 ft of where you started or where you arrive is knocked Prone.

automation.note: Target the enemies within 5 ft of your starting point and of your destination, then Use to knock them Prone (no save). Move your token up to 60 ft.
